The '''ASP-9''' was a [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|slugthrower pistol]] produced by [[Talus Ironworks/Legends|Talus Ironworks]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was nicknamed "[[Vrelt/Legends|Vrelt]]," from a small [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] found in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].
